lecture_13.title: CS336 Spring 2026, Lecture 13: Data I (sources and datasets)
lecture_13.note: Line anchors refer to the local shallow clone (sha256 321fbab6..., recorded in discovered.json). Unlike lectures 2, 6 and 10 this file has no @inspect values and no model code: it is 390 text() claims, 54 link()/article_link() citations and 18 image() calls, so every KP is 'said', 'cited' or 'shown' and nothing is 'computed'. Numbers the professor types into text() about a dataset's own construction (C4: 1.4 trillion tokens in, 156 billion out; Gopher: 10.5 TB but trained on 300B, 12%; The Stack: 51B files, 5B unique; DCLM: 240T pool to 3.8T; RefinedWeb: 600B of 5T; Nemotron-CC: 6.3T, HQ 1.1T) are quoted as the professor's readings of the cited papers. Numbers that live only on a linked external page (April 2026 crawl 2.19 billion pages / 372.2 TB, Google index 100 PB, Wikipedia 67 million articles, GitHub 420M+ repositories, arXiv ~3M submissions, Software Heritage 28.8M files, LibGen ~4M books, Sci-Hub ~88M papers, Smashwords 150K authors, Steven Pruitt 5M edits) are recorded with role 'citation' and are never prompt answers. Numbers that exist only inside embedded images (llama3-data.png, olmo2-pretraining/dolmino/tulu.png, decline-consent.png, anthropic-crawling.png, dclm-wet.png, c4-domains.png, the-pile.png, the Dolma medium figure, dclm-filter/quality.png, nemotron-results.png, stackv2-pr1/2.png, commonpile.png, comma-results.png) are recorded only as 'shown'. Two likely typos in the source are left as-is: L288 'Steven Pruit' and L309, where the 'GitHub Archive' link points at the arXiv S3 bulk-data page (the same URL the professor uses correctly at L327).
